draft_en.subject: Re: Marvell Managed Commercial Switches
draft_en.body:
Hello Yogendra,

Two of your questions never got a proper answer from us - apologies, here they are.

1. L3 switch with 8 GB RAM and 16 GB flash (your 20 January question): no. Our L3 units are CENTEC-based with 2 GB DRAM and 8 GB eMMC flash (the 400G platform has 4 GB DRAM). If the 8 GB / 16 GB line comes from a tender sheet, it rules us out on paper, and I would rather say so now than send a datasheet that does not match.

2. Costing for the Marvell managed commercial range (31 March) and SKD: 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x 10G SFP+, L2+ managed - model STC-424XGGPM-280W - $180 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x 2.5G SFP, L2+ managed - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity). These are built-unit prices from Shenzhen. SKD kits for assembly in India are possible, but only as a volume programme with a yearly quantity behind them; the kit price depends on how much of the assembly you take on.

3. Sourcing from outside China: we cannot offer that. Units and kits ship from Shenzhen, and BIS registration stays on your side either way.

One question: for an SKD programme, what yearly quantity per model would you commit to? That tells me whether it is worth preparing a kit BOM for you.

Thank you.
Elsa
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
